The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: The Menologion miniature is described as Polyeuctus of Melitene, martyr, and placed among its beheadings - the folder's soldier of Melitene in Armenia beheaded under Decius and Valerian, not the later patriarch Polyeuctus of Constantinople. Commons describes it: Полиевкт Мелитинский, мч. Константинополь. 985 г. Миниатюра Минология Василия II.  Ватиканская библиотека. Рим.
